services.name: Executive Planner
services.description: Plans goals into scheduled projects, decomposes them into milestones/tasks, manages their lifecycle (status/progress/artifacts), groups them under companies, and consolidates recent activity into executive summaries.

services.name: Learning Engine
services.description: Tracks department/agent/tool execution outcomes and duration, and generates optimization recommendations from the aggregated performance data.

services.name: Automation Engine
services.description: Persisted job queue with retry/backoff and a recurring scheduler for background jobs (nightly consolidation, learning recommendations). The tick loop only runs while a long-running host process (the dashboard server) has started it.
